name: telco-reliability-lab
description: Performance & Reliability Testing Suite over a Telco self-care demo platform (k6, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Tempo, Loki).

scripts.k6:smoke:prom: docker compose run --rm -e K6_OUT=experimental-prometheus-rw k6 run /scripts/scenarios/smoke.js
scripts.k6:load:prom: docker compose run --rm -e K6_OUT=experimental-prometheus-rw k6 run /scripts/scenarios/load.js
scripts.k6:degradation:prom: docker compose run --rm -e K6_OUT=experimental-prometheus-rw k6 run /scripts/scenarios/degradation.js
